text: ACTION REQUIRED: Your account will be suspended in 2 hours. Provide your card number to verify ownership: +7 701 555 0177
label: scam
notes: urgency_time_pressure + card_data_request. Suspension threat with explicit card request.

text: Your Halyk Bank transfer of 25,000 KZT to account ending 7731 was processed at 14:32. If unrecognised, call 595.
label: legitimate
notes: Real bank transfer notification. Official number 595. No data request.

text: You have won the EXPO grand lottery! Claim your 100,000 KZT prize: expo-winner.top/claim — expires in 48 hours.
label: scam
notes: risky_tld (.top) + urgency_time_pressure. Fake lottery.

text: Dear student, your final exam results for Statistics are now available in the Narxoz student portal.
label: legitimate
notes: University notification. No signals.

text: Your OTP code is 72048. Enter it on the Kaspi.kz website to confirm your payment. Never share this code.
label: legitimate
notes: OTP with 'enter on the site' + 'never share'. Official kaspi.kz domain. Must be legitimate.

text: Police notice: your car has been reported for a traffic violation. Pay the fine of 15,000 KZT within 3 days at: police-kz.top/fine
label: scam
notes: lookalike_domain (police-kz.top) + urgency_time_pressure + transfer_request. Fake government fine.

text: Hi! Reminder that our team meeting is moved to 3 PM today. Conference room B.
label: legitimate
notes: Internal work message. No signals.

text: Confirm your subscription renewal: reply YES to continue at 1,500 KZT/month. Reply STOP to cancel.
label: legitimate
notes: Service renewal message. No request for sensitive data. No urgency threat.

text: Your Kaspi card is temporarily blocked due to suspicious activity. To unblock, reply with your PIN and card number.
label: scam
notes: card_data_request (PIN + card number). Banks never ask for PIN by SMS.

text: Delivery notification: your order #81234 from Wildberries has arrived at the pickup point on Abay Ave. Available until Dec 2.
label: legitimate
notes: Legitimate delivery pickup notice. No signals, no payment request.

text: FINAL WARNING: A criminal case has been opened in your name for tax evasion. To stop proceedings, transfer 80,000 KZT to a safe account: 4169 7382 9100 2244.
label: scam
notes: transfer_request + urgency_threat ('criminal case', 'final warning'). Classic 'safe account' scam.

text: Thank you for your donation to the Red Crescent Society of Kazakhstan. Your reference number is RCK-20261127-449.
label: legitimate
notes: Receipt confirmation. No signals.

text: Loan approved! 500,000 KZT available. To activate, send your full name, IIN, and card expiry date.
label: scam
notes: card_data_request (card expiry) + IIN request. Fake loan activation.

text: Call me
label: legitimate
notes: Very short, no signals. Edge case.

text: asdfjkl qwerty zxcvbnm 12345 !!!???
label: legitimate
notes: Gibberish. No meaningful signals. System should handle gracefully.

label: suspicious
notes: Bare IP address link. Expected ip_link signal -> suspicious.

text: Your code: 11111. Ваш код: 11111. Сіздің кодыңыз: 11111.
label: legitimate
notes: Triple-language OTP, all three languages at once. No data request. Must be legitimate.

text: Kaspi Bank: Ваш аккаунт заблокирован. Your account is blocked. Verify at: kaspi-verify.top/en
label: scam
notes: Russian + English. lookalike_domain (kaspi-verify.top) + urgency_threat. Bilingual phishing.

text: Order confirmed / Тапсырыс расталды. Delivery in 3-5 days / Жеткізу 3-5 күнде.
label: legitimate
notes: Bilingual Kazakh-English order confirmation. No signals.

text: You owe 3,200 KZT for last month. Мерзімді өткізіп алмаңыз — сіздің шотыңыз бүгін бұғатталады. Pay now: 4169 8800 1122 3344.
label: scam
notes: Kazakh + English. urgency_threat ('шотыңыз бүгін бұғатталады') + transfer_request (card number in text). Mixed-language scam.

text: Hi Aizat! Just checking if you got my earlier message. Send me the SMS code you received — it is for the shared work account.
label: scam
notes: code_request (social engineering, asks to forward OTP). Informal English. No urgency but explicit code request.

text: Добрый день! Your invoice #2026-1842 is ready. Download it here: docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123
label: legitimate
notes: Russian greeting + English body. Google Docs link (not a shortener or lookalike). Legitimate business message.

text: Акция! Special offer for Narxoz students: 50% discount on gym membership. Register before Nov 30: forms.gle/xyz
label: legitimate
notes: Promotional message. Google Forms link. No data request or urgency threat.
